title: Direct Name Lookup
description: Pull up a direct link to a username history of an account!
body:
Ever wanted to quickly check someones past usernames? Figure out who someone is, but don't want to search through your browser? This brings the functionality straight to the game! Simply just type /names (username) into chat for a quick link that'll give you a persons past usernames!
Created by **Distressed**, modified by **Sylveee**.
![The command in use!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d4f1110f4cbdee8bca6a159c97794ac71f06931.png)
